hints.title: Maximum Overlap Duality
hints.text: Dividing intervals into non-overlapping groups is equivalent to finding the maximum number of mutually overlapping intervals at any point in time.

hints.title: Start Time Order
hints.text: Sort the intervals in non-decreasing order of their start values.

hints.title: End Time Priority Queue
hints.text: Maintain a min-priority queue of the end times of active groups. If the earliest finishing group ends before current interval start, reuse that group; otherwise create a new group.

hints.title: Interval Group Partition Implementation

complexity.notes: Sorting takes O(n log n); each interval executes priority queue push and pop in O(log n).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Assigning intervals to groups using pairwise overlap checks results in O(n^2) runtime.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Min-heap tracks group end times to greedily assign the best available group.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identifies equivalence to maximum concurrent interval overlap solved via priority queue or sweep-line.
